The argument where it doesn't need to be cleared within 6 rounds or less to get necessary rewards has its certain merits of course, but the main complaint I've seen (and also my personal complaint as well) is actually just that these enemies and the environment forces you to stick on the archetype's gameplay and punishes you if you're not using it. If you played Voyages of Volatility before, that is honestly more well-implemented than the "shill" mode that we've gotten.

Nonetheless, I always give them praise on Reveries because they actually peaked on that gamemode. It was one of the most fun endgame modes I've played and I'm still attempting weird clears because the environments and the myth accessibilities were definitely fun to comprehend.
